en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an industrial gasworks complex with several brick buildings, a tall smokestack, and a large round gas holder. In the foreground runs a street with a cyclist and a pedestrian, and there is a fenced-off area and gateway leading into the facility. The printing at the top in red German text identifies the location as Brockwitz–Sörnewitz and describes the gasworks on Bahnhofstraße.
